name: Karentia Berrybell
original_name: カーレンティア・ヴェリーベル
source:
A second-year music student at Laikask Academy who plays the violin. Her nickname is Katia. She's the daughter of the head of the prestigious Verybell family, who have a long history of producing talented musicians.

Ever since a young age, she's received special instruction to hone her talents. Now, her skill exceeds that of most professionals. Not only is she renowned across the school, but across the entire country as well.

She's led a somewhat solitary life, devoting all her time toward the violin, but will that change?
